cardReaderCallsPagesTitle: Allow these calls and web pages?
cardReaderPagesHow: Every row comes ticked; untick any you do not want opened. Each ticked page opens once, signed out, and after that the crewmate may read that address again.
cardReaderPagesLead: The crewmate on “{task}” reads words anyone can write and now holds something of yours, so each new web address it opens waits for you: an address can carry what it read to whoever runs the site. Each row is one page, with its whole address.
cardReaderUnsafeData: This crewmate reads words anyone can write, so a link or request on this card may come from a stranger.
cardReaderWritesHow: Every row comes ticked; untick any you do not want sent. The ticked rows go once each, oldest first, with your {place} sign-in.
cardReaderWritesLead: The crewmate on “{task}” reads words anyone can write, so every write it makes on {place} waits for you. Each row is one call and the request it sends.
